mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in the federal funds rate over three months signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns within five trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% monthly indicate weakening demand, triggering negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) signals strong labor market momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate hiring and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month consecutive decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals supply chain disruption, reducing corporate output and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising residential construction (HOUST) indicates strong housing market activity, serving as a leading indicator for consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns within five trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve policy tightening that increases equity discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases (UNRATE > 4.5%) and non-farm payroll declines (PAYEMS < 0.2% monthly) indicate labor market deterioration, triggering negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending and corporate hiring.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.5% and PAYEMS decline > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% and PAYEMS declines > 0.2% in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
